title: Utair: 401.4K accounts breached
summary: In August 2020, news broke of a data breach of Russian airline Utair that dated back to the previous year. The breach contained over 400k unique email addresses along with extensive personal information including names, physical addresses, dates of birth, passport numbers and loyalty program details

title: Медицинская лаборатория Гемотест (Gemotest): 6.3M accounts breached
summary: In April 2022, Russian pharmaceutical company Gemotest suffered a data breach that exposed 31 million patients. The data contained 6.3 million unique email addresses along with names, physical addresses, dates of birth, passport and insurance numbers. Gemotest was later fined for the breach.

title: AUTOSUR: 487.2K accounts breached
summary: In March 2025, the French vehicle inspection company AUTOSUR suffered a data breach exposing over 10M customer records, though only 487k unique email addresses were present. title: The Botting Network: 96.3K accounts breached
summary: In August 2012, the forum for making money with botting "The Botting Network" suffered a data breach that exposed 96k user records. The now defunct vBulletin forum leaked 96k email addresses, usernames, dates of birth and salted MD5 password hashes.

title: Web Hosting Talk: 515.1K accounts breached
summary: In July 2016, the Web Hosting Talk forum suffered a data breach that was subsequently listed for sale. The breach of the vBulletin based forum exposed 515k user records including usernames, email addresses, IP addresses and salted MD5 password hashes.

title: KinoKong: 817.8K accounts breached
summary: In March 2021, the Russian online streaming service KinoKong suffered a data breach that was later redistributed as part of a larger corpus of data. The breach exposed over 800k unique email addresses along with names, usernames, IP addresses and MD5 password hashes.

title: Zilvia.net: 287.9K accounts breached
